meta.title: 🇻🇳 How to Apply Vietnam E Visa! | Complete Guide!
meta.description:
🇻🇳 **VIETNAM E VISA FOR INDIANS 2026 | COMPLETE STEP-BY-STEP TUTORIAL**

Planning a trip to Vietnam and want to apply for your **Vietnam E Visa yourself** instead of paying an agent?

In this video, I have explained the **complete Vietnam E Visa application process step by step**, especially for Indian travellers. I have kept the process simple and easy to understand so that you can follow each step and submit your application with confidence.

Many Indian travellers prefer taking help from agents or other people to complete their Vietnam visa application. However, if you understand the process correctly, you can complete the application yourself.

📌 **In this Vietnam E Visa tutorial, you will learn:**

✅ How to apply for Vietnam E Visa online
✅ Step-by-step Vietnam E Visa application process
✅ How to fill the Vietnam E Visa application form
✅ What information you need before starting the application
✅ How to upload your photograph and passport details
✅ How to check your application information
✅ Vietnam E Visa payment process
✅ How to track/check your Vietnam E Visa application
✅ How to download your approved Vietnam E Visa
✅ Important points to check before submitting your application
✅ Common mistakes applicants should avoid

This video is particularly useful for **Indians travelling to Vietnam for tourism** who want to understand the complete visa process and apply on their own.
.
.
Application Form Link: https://evisa.gov.vn/
.
.
🎯 **Who should watch this video?**

This tutorial is useful if you are planning to visit **Vietnam from India**, travelling for tourism, or simply want to understand how the Vietnam E Visa application works before submitting your application.

📢 **Watch the complete video before starting your application**, as I have explained the process step by step and highlighted important details that applicants should pay attention to.

If you find this video helpful, **LIKE the video, SHARE it with someone planning a Vietnam trip, and SUBSCRIBE to The Visa Venue** for more visa guides, immigration updates, travel information and application tutorials.

⚠️ **Disclaimer:** Visa rules, fees, processing procedures and application requirements can change. Always verify the latest information on the official Vietnam immigration website before submitting your application.

comments.text: I’m travelling from India to Phu Quoc with a transit in Kuala Lumpur. I’ll stay in Phu Quoc under the 30-day Phu Quoc visa exemption, and on my return I’ll fly Phu Quoc → Ho Chi Minh City (domestic Terminal 1), then transfer to International Terminal 2 and fly to Hyderabad on the same PNR, with baggage re-check. For this return journey, do I need a Vietnam e-visa, and will Vietnamese departure immigration check my visa/immigration status during the T1-to-T2 transfer?

comments.author: @TheVisaVenue
comments.text: No need for an e-visa as you're not entering Vietnam.
